senses.gloss:
नह् 1. नह्, cl. 4. P. A. नह्यति, -ते, न-
नाह, नेहे, नद्धा, नत्स्यति, -ते, अनात्-
सीत्, अनद्ध, नद्धुम्, to bind, tie, bind on, bind
round, put on, gird round, bind together; A. to put
on one's self, dress, put on armour, arm one's self:
Caus. नाहयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अनीनहत्, to cause
to bind or tie together, to cause to put on: Desid.
निनत्सति, -ते: Intens. नानह्यते, नानद्धि; [cf.
Gr. νέ-ω, νή-θ-ω, νῆ-μα, νῆ-σι-ς, νῆ-τρο-ν, νέ-ω,
Intens. νη-νέ-ω, νη-έ-ω: Lat. ne-o, ne-men, ne-
tu-s, nec-t-o, nexu-s: Old Germ. nā-an, nāw-an,
nāh-an, ‘to sew;’ nā-dal, ‘needle;’ nah, ‘near:’
Goth. nethla, ‘a needle;’ nēhva, ‘near:’ Angl. Sax.
naedl, ‘needle;’ neah, neh-st, nearra: Eng. nigh:
Mod. Germ. näh-en, nad-el, nah, nach, ge-nug:
Hib. nasgaim, ‘I bind;’ nas, ‘a tie.’]
2. नह्, त्, f., Ved. a bond, tie; [cf. अक्षा-न्˚.]

नाह नाह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. नह्), binding,
confinement; a trap, a snare for catching deer &c.;
obstruction in any organ or secretion of the body, as
costiveness &c.

नहन, अम्, n., Ved. a bolt, a nail or connecting
beam in a wall.

नह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being bound, tied, or
fettered.

नहि न-हि, ind. for not, surely not, cer-
tainly not, by no means, not at all; न-नहि, cer-
tainly not; (नहि is sometimes strengthened in the
Veda by other particles, e. g. नह्य् अङ्ग, नहि नु,
नहि स्म.)
—नहि-मात्र, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a particular high number; [cf. न-मात्र.]

नहुस् नहुस्, उस्, m. a man, one who does
not belong to one's own immediate community, a
neighbour [cf. नाभि; Mod. Germ. nahe]; (collec-
tively) the neighbourhood.

नहुष, अस्, m., Ved. = नहुस्, a man; N. of a
son of Manu and author of a Ṛg-veda hymn; N. of
an ancient king, one of the lunar race, son of Āyus
and grandson of Purū-ravas, father of Yayāti, who
took possession of Indra's throne in heaven for a
time, but was afterwards deposed and changed into a
serpent; (according to others) a son of Ambarīṣa,
father of Nābhāga; N. of a serpent-demon; N. of a
Marut; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa-Viṣṇu; [cf. नघु-
ष, नाहुष, नाहुषि.]
—नहुष-चरित, अम्,
n. ‘the life of Nahuṣa,’ N. of the 112th chapter
of the Bhūmi-khaṇḍa of the Padma-Purāṇa.
—न-
हुषाख्य (˚ष-आख्˚), अम्, n. the plant Taber-
næmontana Coronaria (= तगर-पुष्प).
—न-
हुषात्मज (˚ष-आत्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king, the
son of Nahuṣa, also called Yayāti.

नाहुष 1. नाहुष, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. नहुस्), Ved.
neighbouring, being in the vicinity, neighbourly?;
(Sāy.) human, belonging to men; (अस्), m. a
neighbour.

नाहुष 2. नाहुष, अस्, m. (fr. नहुष), a
patronymic of Yayāti; N. of a serpent-demon; [cf.
नहुष.]

नहुष्टर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. nearer (?), nearer
than a neighbour.

नहुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a de-
scendant of Nahus, belonging to a man in general,
human; (अस्), m. a man.

नाहल नाहल, अस्, m. a man of a bar-
barous or outcast tribe; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a non-
Āryan people (= म्लेच्छ).
नाहुषि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Yayāti.
